🇳🇵 Nepal–Tibet Border Avalanche & Flood | 26 August 2026 A major ice–rock avalanche near the Nepal–Tibet border triggered a cascading hazard: a large glacier mass collapsed from high elevation, sending ice, rock and sediment into the Lhende Khola. The debris blocked the river and formed a temporary barrier lake, which then released a powerful downstream surge of muddy water, debris and boulders. 🌡️ Possible factors: glacier instability, melting ice, steep crevassed terrain, meltwater lubrication and possible seismic triggering. ⚠️ Some claims remain unconfirmed, so the exact trigger requires scientific investigation. 🌊 Avalanche → Debris Flow → River Blockage → Dam Breach → Flood #Nepal #NepalFlood #NepalLandslide #NepalAvalanche #NepalTibetBorder Himalayas HimalayanAvalanche Landslide GlacierCollapse GlacialLake BarrierLake FlashFlood DebrisFlow LhendeKhola Bhotekoshi ClimateChange GlacierMelt NaturalDisaster DisasterScience EarthScience 26August2026

🚨 A 6-year-old girl was rescued alive after spending approximately 55 to 60 hours trapped beneath flood debris in Timure, Rasuwa District, Nepal. Members of Nepal’s Armed Police Force worked through mud and wreckage before reaching the child, identified in reports as Manisha, and safely pulling her from the destruction. 🙏 The girl received immediate medical assistance and was reportedly transferred to Kathmandu for further care. Information about her parents remained unclear following the rescue, which has become a powerful moment of hope amid the devastating floods that have claimed numerous lives across Nepal. #Nepal #Rasuwa #Rescue #Floods #SurvivalStory

A heartbreaking moment has emerged from the devastating floods in Nepal after a woman was rescued by the Nepal Army from a flood-hit area. After being brought to safety, she was seen sitting in shock, struggling to process the destruction around her. She had survived the dangerous floodwaters, but the disaster had left her facing the painful reality of losing everything she had. The emotional scene reflects the devastating impact of the floods on ordinary families across Nepal. For many survivors, escaping the water is only the beginning of a long and difficult journey to rebuild their lives.
